styles.container: max-width: 740px; margin: 0 auto; padding: 20px; font-family: 'Songti SC', 'SimSun', Georgia, serif; font-size: 16px; line-height: 2 !important; color: #333333 !important; background-color: #f8f4e9 !important; word-wrap: break-word; letter-spacing: 1px;
styles.h1: font-size: 28px; font-weight: 700; color: #8b1e22 !important; line-height: 1.8 !important; margin: 48px 0px 24px; padding: 20px; background: linear-gradient(135deg, #8b1e22, #333333) !important; -webkit-background-clip: text; -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent; text-align: center; letter-spacing: 4px; border-bottom: 3px solid #8b1e22; text-shadow: 2px 2px 4px rgba(139, 30, 34, 0.3);
styles.h2: font-size: 22px; font-weight: 700; color: #8b1e22 !important; line-height: 1.8 !important; margin: 40px 0px 20px; padding: 15px 0px 15px 25px; border-left: 6px solid #8b1e22; background: linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(139, 30, 34, 0.1), transparent) !important; letter-spacing: 2px;
styles.h3: font-size: 20px; font-weight: 600; color: #333333 !important; line-height: 1.8 !important; margin: 36px 0px 18px; padding: 10px 0px 10px 20px; border-left: 4px solid #333333; letter-spacing: 1.5px;
styles.h4: font-size: 18px; font-weight: 600; color: #666666 !important; line-height: 1.8 !important; margin: 32px 0px 16px; padding: 8px 0px 8px 16px; border-left: 3px solid #666666;
styles.h5: font-size: 16px; font-weight: 600; color: #8b1e22 !important; line-height: 1.8 !important; margin: 28px 0px 14px; padding: 6px 0px 6px 12px; border-left: 2px solid #8b1e22;
styles.h6: font-size: 15px; font-weight: 600; color: #999999 !important; line-height: 1.8 !important; margin: 24px 0px 12px; padding: 4px 0px 4px 10px; border-left: 1px solid #999999;
styles.p: margin: 24px 0px !important; line-height: 2 !important; color: #333333 !important; text-align: justify; text-indent: 2em; letter-spacing: 1px;
styles.strong: font-weight: 700; color: #8b1e22 !important; background-color: rgba(139, 30, 34, 0.1) !important; padding: 2px 6px; border-radius: 4px; border-bottom: 2px dotted #8b1e22;
styles.em: font-style: italic; color: #666666 !important; font-family: 'KaiTi', cursive; text-decoration: underline wavy #8b1e22;
styles.a: color: #8b1e22 !important; text-decoration: none; border-bottom: 2px dotted #8b1e22; font-weight: 600; transition: all 0.3s ease;
styles.ul: margin: 24px 0px; padding-left: 32px; list-style-type: circle; background-color: rgba(139, 30, 34, 0.05) !important; padding: 20px; border: 1px solid #d4c5a0; border-radius: 8px;
styles.ol: margin: 24px 0px; padding-left: 32px; list-style-type: upper-roman; background-color: rgba(139, 30, 34, 0.05) !important; padding: 20px; border: 1px dashed #8b1e22; border-radius: 8px;
styles.li: margin: 12px 0px; line-height: 2 !important; color: #333333 !important; padding-left: 10px; position: relative;
styles.blockquote: margin: 36px 0px; padding: 25px 35px; background-color: #f0ebe1 !important; border-left: 6px solid #8b1e22; border-right: 6px solid #8b1e22; color: #333333 !important; font-style: italic; text-align: center; font-family: 'KaiTi', cursive; border-radius: 0; box-shadow: inset 0 0 20px rgba(139, 30, 34, 0.1);
styles.code: font-family: 'FangSong', monospace; font-size: 14px; padding: 4px 8px; background-color: #f0ebe1 !important; color: #8b1e22 !important; border: 2px solid #8b1e22; border-radius: 4px; font-weight: 600;
styles.pre: margin: 32px 0px; padding: 25px; background-color: #f0ebe1 !important; color: #333333 !important; border-left: 6px solid #8b1e22; overflow-x: auto; line-height: 1.8 !important; font-family: 'FangSong', monospace; box-shadow: inset 5px 0 10px rgba(139, 30, 34, 0.1);
styles.hr: margin: 48px auto; border: none; width: 60%; height: 3px; background: linear-gradient(to right, transparent, #8b1e22, #d4c5a0, #8b1e22, transparent); border-radius: 2px;
styles.img: max-width: 100%; max-height: 600px !important; height: auto; display: block; margin: 36px auto; border: 4px solid #8b1e22; border-radius: 0; box-shadow: 8px 8px 15px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.2); padding: 8px; background-color: #f8f4e9 !important;
styles.table: width: 100%; margin: 32px 0px; border-collapse: separate; border-spacing: 0; font-size: 15px; border: 3px solid #8b1e22; background-color: #f8f4e9 !important; border-radius: 0;
styles.th: background: linear-gradient(135deg, #8b1e22, #d4c5a0) !important; color: #f8f4e9 !important; padding: 16px 20px; text-align: center; font-weight: 700; border: 1px solid #333333; font-family: 'KaiTi', cursive; font-size: 16px; text-shadow: 1px 1px 2px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3);
styles.td: padding: 14px 18px; border: 1px solid #d4c5a0; color: #333333 !important; background-color: rgba(248, 244, 233, 0.9) !important; text-align: center; font-family: 'Songti SC', serif;
